contexts.text: Some are punished in a certain court among snakes.
The snake in the grass is not seen.
Like a snake put to the fire.
He was turned into coils of snakes.
Snakes seen, crawling in a court. Explained.
A snake or serpent appeared in the fold.

He leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him () = that when such a one consults the Word in the sense of the letter, seeking goods, he does not see that evils pervert him. The bite of a snake = falsification from the interior dominion of falsity from evil.
